data.text:
Does the default [bugs].repro_env CLAUDE* record operator identity (Claude Code account/org UUIDs and the socket path) into the committed repro bundle?
Yes: repro_facts.environment matches env names against repro_env, and CLAUDE* matches CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_OWNER_*_UUID and the bridge socket, whose names carry no secret-word, so their values enter the blob and are printed by ddflow show.

Read the governing rules from gate status (r-consent-outward, r-gemini-key-load, r-task-phase-needs-wave); the fix narrows a default so operator identity no longer leaves the project without recorded consent.
